name: 邱家吉
objective: This is the first course in numerical analysis for graduate students. The objectives of the course include: (1) Development and applications of numerical methods when analytical techniques are not available; (2) Numerical differentiation and integration; (3) Numerical solution of ODEs and PDEs; (4) To get familiar with different types of commercial software.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction, some useful software and python, Interpolation (Homework 1)
Week 2 Numerical differentiation (Homework 2)
Week 3 Numerical integration (Homework 3)
Week 4 Numerical solution of ODEs
Week 5 Numerical solution of ODEs (Homework 4)
Week 6 Numerical solution of PDEs
Week 7 Numerical solution of PDEs (Homework 5)
Week 8 (Midterm break)
Week 9 DFT and FFT
Week 10 Finite element method
Week 11 Finite element method: COMSOL
Week 12 (Conference break)
Week 13 Finite difference method: FLAC
Week 14 Discrete element method: 3DEC
Week 15 Discrete element method: PFC
Week 16 Presentation and discussion
Week 17-18 Report adjustment and submission
materials: Parviz Moin (2010), Fundamentals of engineering numerical analysis, second edition. Cambridge University press.
consultation: 寫 Email 或至材資館 304 室找老師
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks: During Weeks 17-18, students are required to improve their work based on the feedback received from the Week 16 oral presentations, and submit the revised written report for final grading.
